title: Doorstep Parcel Pickup
description: Schedule parcel pickup from your preferred location so riders can collect shipments without requiring you to visit a delivery counter.

title: Express & Standard Delivery
description: Send parcels across Bangladesh with flexible delivery speed. Use express service for urgent local parcels and standard delivery for regular shipments.

title: Live Parcel Tracking
description: Track every important update from pickup to delivery through your dashboard, including rider activity and parcel status changes.

title: Nationwide Delivery Coverage
description: Send parcels to supported service areas across Bangladesh with organized pickup, warehouse handling, and final delivery updates.

title: Secure Parcel Handling
description: Every parcel is handled through a structured delivery process so packages stay traceable and protected from pickup to delivery.

title: Delivery History Dashboard
description: View parcel requests, payment activity, delivery progress, and completed shipment records from your dashboard whenever you need them.
